name: PixelDecode
tagline: ESP32-S3 pixel decoders that take an Art-Net/sACN/DDP stream and drive WS281x, SK6812 and APA102 pixels without a PC in the loop.
description: Custom PCBAs built around the ESP32-S3. Level-shifted outputs, fused power, 4- or 8-pin pixel headers and a USB-C console. Runs open firmware you can flash from the browser.

name: PixelPilot
tagline: A Raspberry Pi control interface that schedules, previews and pushes shows to every PixelDecode board on the network.
description: A HAT plus SD image for a Raspberry Pi 4/5. Web UI on the local network, show scheduler, live preview, board discovery and OTA firmware updates for the whole fleet.
